name: Women
overview: Scripture reveals that women were intentionally created by God as a distinct and essential part of His design, made in His image alongside men (Genesis 1:27). The creation of woman from man’s rib underscores her role as a suitable helper and companion, designed for partnership and unity within marriage (Genesis 2:18, 21-24). This foundational truth highlights the divine purpose and dignity bestowed upon women from the very beginning.
